$comment: Single source of truth for scripts/build_adapters.py. Edit this file and adapters/source/roles/*.md, then run `python scripts/build_adapters.py`. Commands, playbooks and their references live in skills/telegram-bot-ui/commands/index.json; roles name the commands (`verbs`) they carry out; `llms` globs are relative to the repository root. Paths that do not exist yet are skipped in indexes (llms.txt) but kept in role bodies, which tell the agent to say so instead of guessing.

install.host: Any host with the GitHub CLI
commands: gh skill install hlibsuslov/telegram-bot-ui telegram-bot-ui --agent <claude-code|codex|cursor|gemini|copilot> --scope user

install.host: Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot (from a clone)

plugin.description: The whole interface of a Telegram bot on the newest Bot API: screens, texts and keyboards, navigation and states, streaming AI replies, HTML widgets, premium emoji, product flows, channel publishing, agent-operated bots and Bot API lookups, plus the local bot-ui Studio to map and edit it. Bundles the telegram-bot-ui skill and five subagents.
plugin.author: hlibsuslov

codex.short_description: The whole interface of a Telegram bot on the newest Bot API: screens, texts, keyboards, navigation and states, streaming AI replies with Stop, private panels in groups, Rich Messages, HTML widgets and TON wallet flows, premium emoji packs, whole product flows, channel publishing with approval, agent-operated bots and offline Bot API lookups. Preserves callback_data, deep links, handlers and translations.
codex.default_prompt: Use $telegram-bot-ui to audit this Telegram bot's screens and propose fixes.
codex.plugin_short_description: The whole UI of a Telegram bot, updated for every Bot API release

exclude_sections: Start: every activation, in this order

roles.name: telegram-bot-designer
roles.description: Audits and designs Telegram bot screens (the skill's audit command and the proposal half of improve): builds the screen/state map, finds real UX defects, saves them as findings, and proposes exact texts, keyboards and navigation. Use for "review this bot's menu", "redesign the onboarding", "why does the bot feel confusing". Never edits the project's code; writes only the saved review in bot-ui/context/.

roles.name: telegram-bot-builder
roles.description: Implements Telegram bot features from the telegram-bot-ui recipes and validators: menus, forms, streaming replies with Stop, ephemeral panels, Rich Messages, widgets, SDK adapters for missing Bot API methods. Use when the design is agreed and code must change, with tests.

roles.name: telegram-publisher
roles.description: Composes, validates, previews and publishes Telegram channel posts through the telegram-bot-ui publishing pipeline and scripts/tg_post.py, with explicit human approval before every publish and no double posts. Use for "post this to our channel", "schedule the weekly digest", "fix how our channel posts look".

roles.name: telegram-widget-builder
roles.description: Designs and builds Bot API 10.4 HTML widgets with the telegram-bot-ui widget design system, build and preview tools and the size validator: live cards, shared polls, tickers, wallet flows. Use for "make the order status an interactive card" or "build a widget".

roles.name: telegram-bot-reviewer
roles.description: Reviews a diff of a Telegram bot against the telegram-bot-ui invariants: one action per button, preserved callback_data, audience safety, single finalization, widget limits, publishing approval, agent allowlists and injection handling, invented Bot API fields. Read-only; reports findings with file:line and the invariant broken.
